chunks: He (may his secret be sanctified) was the Shaykh of the Imamiyya, their foremost representative, and chief of the sect.
Of great rank, great station, trustworthy, reliable, truthful, knowledgeable in hadith, rijal, fiqh, usul, kalam, adab, and all virtues — all of which are attributed to him.
He authored works in every field of Islamic science, and he is the refiner of creedal positions in usul and furu', the one who combined the perfections of the soul in knowledge and action.

key_terms.الرِّجَالِ: rijal — the science of hadith narrator biography and critical evaluation
key_terms.الْأُصُولِ: usul — foundational principles of religion or jurisprudence
key_terms.الْإِمَامِيَّةِ: the Imamiyya — the Twelver Shia community
key_terms.الْفُرُوعِ: furu' — branches of Islamic law (practical legal rulings)
key_terms.ثِقَةٌ: thiqa — trustworthy; a formal positive evaluation in rijal criticism

ai.seo_question: What were the scholarly qualifications of Shaykh al-Ta'ifa according to classical Shia rijal literature?
ai.summary: This biographical entry describes the incomparable scholarly stature of Shaykh al-Ta'ifa (Shaykh al-Tusi, d. 460 AH), the supreme authority of the Imami Shia community, using the technical evaluative vocabulary of classical rijal science. He is praised with the threefold rijal epithet thiqa–'ayn–saduq and enumerated as a master of hadith, rijal, fiqh, usul, kalam, and adab. He is extolled as the comprehensive author across all Islamic sciences, the refiner of creedal positions in both usul and furu', and the one who united perfections of the soul in knowledge and action.
